text: What if the Caribbean was one country?
Plot twist, part of it already was.
In 1958, ten British island territories joined into one country,
the West Indies Federation, from Jamaica all the way to Trinidad.
So what did this country get?
About three million people, its own flag, and its own prime minister.
But here's the catch.
Jamaica sat over 1,800 kilometers from the capital.
In 1961, Jamaica voted to leave.
Trinidad's leader did the math.
One from ten leaves not.
The country lasted just four years.
But that's not even the weirdest part.
They never really split up in cricket.
Fifteen countries and territories still play as one team,
the West Indies.
And they've won the World Cup twice.
And Jamaica has just one thing to say.
So, one Caribbean, or many.
Because honestly...
